docs.title: Pedestrian Dart-out
docs.text:
A pedestrian waits at the kerb 35 m ahead of the ego and runs out across its lane once the ego is within 20 m. The ego must not hit them -- on every lane at the right-hand edge of a road, where the pedestrian steps straight off the kerb into it.

# Every case on the map, one run each
uv run scenario --multirun hydra/sweeper=lanelet_constraint \
    scenario=pedestrian_dart_out/pedestrian_dart_out map=<map>

docs.title: Scenario
docs.text: Ego Constraint search: a lane with no lane on its right, not in a junction, at least 55 m long, excluding the map's lanelets with no 3D model. 5 m along it, 30 km/h. Goal from the search: 50 m along the matched lanelet, past the crossing. Pedestrian On the matched lanelet -- the ego's -- 40 m along it, 3 m to the right of its centre, turned 90° to face across the lane. A walker CARLA refuses inside the kerb is tried again higher up. Initialization Every traffic light green. Pedestrian, once the ego is within 20 m Walk straight ahead at 2 m/s. Pass The ego has come within 3 m of the point 50 m along its lane, 10 m past the crossing. Fail The ego hits the pedestrian, or 25 s pass.

docs.title: Parameters
docs.text: Parameter Value Pedestrian ahead of the ego 35 m (at s = 40 m) Off the lane's centre 3 m to the right Runs out when the ego is within 20 m Walking speed 2 m/s Passed once within 3 m of 10 m past the crossing (s = 50 m) Ego initial speed 30 km/h Timeout 25 s

docs.title: Result
docs.text: Town10HD_Opt, the first case: the search matched lanelet 324, where the ego starts. Result: PASSED.

docs.title: Temporary Stop
docs.text:
The ego starts at a standstill 15 m short of a stop line that no traffic light governs -- a stop sign's. It has to stop at the line and then go again -- on every such stop line of the map.

# Every case on the map, one run each
uv run scenario --multirun hydra/sweeper=lanelet_constraint \
    scenario=temporary_stop/temporary_stop map=<map>

docs.title: Scenario
docs.text: Ego Constraint search: a lanelet with a stop line that is not a traffic light's, excluding the map's lanelets with no 3D model. Position before stop line: 15 m short of it, on the lanelet before when the line is nearer its lanelet's start than that. Goal from the search: the lanelet after the matched one, past the line. Initialization Every traffic light green. Pass The ego has made a temporary stop -- under 0.1 m/s for 0.3 s within 5 m of a stop line -- and is moving at 3 km/h again. The stop lines are read off the map, from the lanelet the ego starts on and up to three after it (lanelet before the stop line, from the search). Fail 12 s pass.

docs.title: Parameters
docs.text: Parameter Value Spawn 15 m before the stop line Ego initial speed 0 km/h Stopped below 0.1 m/s Held for 0.3 s Within 5 m of the stop line Restart speed 3 km/h Stop lines searched the spawn lanelet and 3 lanelets on Timeout 12 s

docs.title: Result
docs.text: Town10HD_Opt, the first case: the search matched lanelet 5164 and the ego starts on lanelet 3095, 39.0 m along it. Result: PASSED.

docs.title: Traffic Light Compliance
docs.text:
The ego starts at a standstill 10 m short of a signalised stop line with every light red. It has to drive up to the line and stop with its front bumper in the stop zone, 0-3 m before it, without crossing it while the light is red; then pull away once it turns green 5 s in -- on every lane that leads into a signalised junction.

# Every case on the map, one run each
uv run scenario --multirun hydra/sweeper=lanelet_constraint \
    scenario=traffic_light_compliance/traffic_light_compliance map=<map>

docs.title: Scenario
docs.text:
Ego Constraint search: a lanelet before a junction lanelet that has a traffic-light stop line, excluding the map's lanelets with no 3D model. Position before stop line: 10 m short of it. Goal: up the road, past the junction. Initialization Every traffic light red. After 5 s Every traffic light green. Pass Both have happened: before the green the ego stood still (0.1 m/s or slower) for 0.5 s with its front bumper 0-3 m before the stop line (the stop zone), and after 5.5 s it was moving at 10 km/h or more. Fail Its front bumper crosses the stop line while the light is red ("ran the red"); or at the green it has not stood still in the stop zone -- standing farther back ("stopped N m before the stop line, outside the stop zone"), stopped in the zone too late ("stopped in the stop zone … only X s before the green: less than standstill_seconds") or still rolling towards the line ("had not stopped by the green: still moving"); or 8 s pass.

Distances are the stop_line_distance_m measure's: along the ego's lane, from its front bumper to the stop line ahead. That measure reads only stop lines ahead, so the scenario keeps the line the ego started before and carries it on the ego's own travel once the reading jumps away -- to the next line, or to nothing -- and a crossing is a negative distance however the measure then reads. The run's result details carry where the ego stopped (stopped_at_stop_line_distance_m) or when and how far it crossed (crossed_at_seconds, crossed_by_m).

Where the measure's reading jumps beyond the line the ego had while that line is still at least 0.5 m ahead -- the other branch's line where the lane forks, the line of the lane it changed out of -- the reading is the ego's own line and is taken; so is a reading that jumps nearer (a lane whose line is staggered nearer). A front bumper up to stop_line_tolerance_m past the line has not crossed it, and counts as at the line (0 m) for the stop zone.

Approaching the line while the light is red is not a failure: an ego that starts 30 m back may roll up to the zone and stop there. One that starts inside the zone has to stay there. Having stood still in the zone is latched: if the ego then rolls back, or creeps on without crossing the line, before the green, it still passes.

The light turns green before the world steps from 5 s, so the step that ends at 5 s still ran under red (a crossing on it runs the red), and the verdict at the green is given on the first step driven under green, from where the ego was on the last red one: a standstill that only completes on the green step does not count.

docs.title: Parameters
docs.text:
Parameter Value Light turns green after 5.0 s Stop zone 0-3 m before the stop line (stop_zone_min_m, stop_zone_max_m) May pass the stop line on red by 0 m (stop_line_tolerance_m) Must have stood still in the stop zone for 0.5 s (standstill_seconds) Counts as standing still at 0.1 m/s or less (standstill_speed_mps) Counts as pulling away on green from 10 km/h Ego initial speed 0 km/h Spawn 10 m before the stop line Timeout 8 s

Note

On Nishi-Shinjuku the search also leaves out lanelet 222, where CARLA's TrafficManager moves the ego onto another lane in the junction.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: Town10HD_Opt, the first case: the search matched lanelet 719, where the ego starts. Result: PASSED. Recorded with scenario.moving_speed_kmh=15, from before the green check had a threshold of its own (departure_speed_kmh); that run was judged by an earlier rule, under which moving on red at 1 km/h or more (15 km/h with that override) failed the run.
